summary: Call a configurable observer model and isolate failures
description: FR-C5-02 and FR-C5-04. HttpObserver posts metadata to a configurable endpoint. run_observer turns observer exceptions into empty guidance.

Do not let an observer exception propagate from run_observer.
Do not call HttpObserver from create_gateway.
